title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19728 missing authorization allowed creating sub-articles without the Create…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions prior to 2026.2.19728 allows users with certain privileges to create sub-articles without having the required Create Article permission. This flaw impacts the integrity of article creation controls but does not affect confidentiality or availability.
